label: improvised, no Store coverage
name: Weighted mean over named components
source: The brief's gradebook weights (memos 60, defenses 20, capstone 20, read from the track file) are combined by a weighted mean. Neither the kernel universal set nor the Store pin supplies a weighted-mean definition, so the arithmetic is written here; the weights stay the customer's.

label: improvised, no Store coverage
name: Rubric band by threshold
source: The track file's own bands (A/B/C/rewrite_below) are read as thresholds; the highest threshold met wins and the lowest named band is the floor. No kernel or Store definition covers rubric banding. The thresholds are the customer's, never a constant in code.
expression: first band whose threshold <= score, highest threshold first

name: Bounded evidence ratio
source: met/total clamped to [0,1], used to turn evidence counts into a criterion fraction; division-by-zero is guarded. Improvised for this platform's grader.

name: Criterion evidence combination
source: The grading policy the operator sets through PLATFORM_EVIDENCE_LENGTH_WEIGHT / COVERAGE_WEIGHT / SOURCE_WEIGHT (defaults 0.5/0.3/0.2), normalised to 1. Improvised: nothing in the kernel or Store covers criterion evidence weighting.
